crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Credit Scoring with Alternative Data
children.blurb: Credit scoring with alternative data covers models that estimate a borrower's likelihood of default or creditworthiness using information beyond the traditional credit bureau file.

children.name: Covenant Extraction
children.blurb: Covenant extraction is the work of turning the terms of credit agreements, indentures, and loan documents into structured data that a credit team can query and monitor.

children.name: Predicting Distress and Default
children.blurb: Predicting distress and default covers the estimation of a borrower's or issuer's likelihood of failing to meet debt obligations over horizons set by the portfolio or regulatory context.

children.name: Modelling the Yield Curve
children.blurb: Modelling the yield curve covers the estimation of the term structure of interest rates from market prices, including spot rates, forward rates, discount factors and par yields.

children.name: Stress Testing Structured Credit
children.blurb: Stress testing structured credit covers securitized products such as RMBS, CMBS, ABS, CLOs and CDOs, and the tranches that sit on top of underlying pools.

sections.body: Fixed income and credit risk is the part of finance concerned with lending, bonds, and the chance that a borrower fails to pay. Artificial intelligence is used here to read loan documents and indentures, to extract covenants and terms, to score borrowers when traditional credit histories are thin, and to flag early signs of distress. In credit scoring with alternative data, models combine payment records, transaction data, and other digital traces to estimate repayment likelihood. In covenant extraction, language models parse legal agreements to find maintenance tests, incurrence tests, and reporting duties. In distress prediction, classifiers and survival models estimate the probability of default and the timing of trouble. In yield curve modelling, statistical and machine learning methods fit the term structure of interest rates and its movements, while in structured credit stress testing, simulations and scenario models examine how pools of loans and tranches behave under shocks.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: Some tasks are relatively mature, but document parsing for covenants works well on clean, standard contracts and struggles with scanned exhibits, unusual drafting, and cross references. Alternative data credit scoring can improve coverage for thin file borrowers, yet it raises fairness, privacy, and stability questions, and its performance can decay when economic conditions change. Distress prediction models can rank risk, but they cannot reliably call the exact timing of a default, and they depend on data that may be stale or incomplete. Yield curve models fit history well, but they are less certain at turning points and around policy shifts. Stress testing structured credit can quantify losses under assumed scenarios, but the results are only as good as the scenarios and the correlations assumed. The honest limit is that AI in this field supports human judgment and speeds up analysis, but it does not remove credit risk or make default predictable with certainty.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: Credit Scoring with Alternative Data is the starting point for how AI estimates borrower quality when conventional files are sparse. Covenant Extraction covers the reading of legal terms that define what a borrower must do and what happens if they do not. Predicting Distress and Default moves from scoring to forward looking risk, with models that estimate failure and its timing. Modelling the Yield Curve provides the rate environment that shapes discounting, refinancing pressure, and credit spreads. Stress Testing Structured Credit brings these threads together by examining how pools of debt and their tranches respond to adverse scenarios. A reader can go to each page for a specific method, or read them in sequence to see how AI moves from a single loan document to a portfolio level stress test.
